pattern: SELECT .+ FROM ([A-Za-z0-9]+) JOIN ([A-Za-z0-9]+) ON ([A-Za-z0-9]+)\.([A-Za-z0-9]+) = ([A-Za-z0-9]+)\.(.+) WHERE .+ > .+ AND .+ > 0 ) AS .+ ON ([A-Za-z0-9]+)\.Code = (.+\.CountryCode)
